speak.title: Role-play: slang in a message to a teacher
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: A student sent you an email full of slang. You did not understand two words and it felt a little rude. Ask what the words mean, explain the problem, and agree a simple rule for messages to you.

b.text: You sent your teacher a friendly message with slang in it. You did not mean it to be rude. Explain what your words mean and why you used them. Ask what is acceptable.

phrases: I didn't mean it to sound rude.
That's fine with friends, but it's not right for an email to me.
I'd like us to agree on a simple rule.
Let's use normal English when we write to teachers.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: what rule did you agree, and is it fair?
